
# Simulating Data 

---

## Simulating Data 

:::{.large}

- We can easily generate data for each model specified with `mlts_model()` using `mlts_sim()`
- Originally designed to test new package implementations, but can also be used to:
  - assess estimation times and estimation performance under specific sample size conditions 
  - conduct simulation studies
  - conduct power analyses 
:::
